aria.lose: Out of hearts. You can restart.
intro.barrier.0: Barriers finish your trail. Use them to enclose space.
intro.barrier.title: Use Barriers
intro.blackhole.0: When activated, continuously pulls nearby enemies.
intro.blackhole.title: Black Hole Orb
intro.blade.0: Pick it up. The ball destroys the next enemy it touches.
intro.blade.title: Blade Orb
intro.bomb.title: Bomb Orb
intro.charger.0: Dashes along the arrow. Freeze to stop it.
intro.charger.title: Charger
intro.eraser.0: Erases the marked area after 3 shots. Freeze to stop it.
intro.eraser.title: Eraser
intro.first.0: Pull and release to launch the ball the other way. Enemies move while the ball rolls
intro.first.1: Connect trails to enclose and claim empty space.
intro.first.2: If an enemy hits an unfinished trail, you lose a heart.
intro.first.title: Connect Trails to Claim
intro.freeze.0: Permanently freezes nearby enemies. Frozen enemies are safe to touch.
intro.freeze.title: Freeze Orb
intro.from-ink.0: You can also start your trail from claimed areas.
intro.from-ink.title: Expand from Ink
intro.jumper.0: Leaps to the marked spot. Freeze to stop it.
intro.jumper.title: Jumper
intro.nest.0: Spawns an enemy every 3 shots. Destroy or freeze it.
intro.nest.title: Nest
intro.protect.0: Grants a shield that blocks one hit. Lasts until used.
intro.protect.title: Shield Orb
intro.shooter.0: Fires a bullet. Bullets can also break trails.
intro.shooter.title: Shooter
intro.two.0: You cannot claim spaces that have enemies inside.
intro.two.title: Two Enemies
toast.blackhole: Black hole keeps pulling nearby enemies
toast.enemiesRemain: Cannot claim areas with enemies inside
toast.freeze: Froze nearby enemies · Frozen bodies are harmless
toast.mark: Eraser targeted claimed area · Erases in {count} shots
toast.trailOnly: Trail finished. Connect trails to enclose space
intro.boss.title: Boss
intro.boss.0: A giant enemy. It takes several blade or bomb hits to destroy.
intro.boost.title: Boost Pad
intro.boost.0: Speeds the ball up along the arrows.
intro.mud.title: Swamp
intro.mud.0: The ball slows down and stops easily. Enemies cross as usual.
intro.haven.title: Safe Zone
intro.spikes.title: Spikes
intro.spikes.0: Whatever touches them gets hurt: the ball loses a heart, enemies are destroyed.
intro.chaser.title: Chaser
intro.chaser.0: Follows the ball during the whole shot. Freeze to stop it.
intro.heart.title: Heart Orb
intro.splitter.title: Splitter
intro.splitter.0: Splits into two small enemies when destroyed. Frozen, it does not split.
intro.mine.title: Mine
intro.mine.0: Explodes soon after the ball enters its ring, destroying nearby enemies and unfinished trails.
intro.ink.title: Ink Orb
intro.ink.0: Claims the area around the spot you hit.
